label: canon-c19-e2soft-tb
_why: THE TIE-BREAKER of canon_c19_e2soft_n2.json: the third run of the 2+1 rule, launched ONLY when alignment_check.mjs exits 2 on that pair. Read as its own session and pooled with the pair (--arm sessA,sessB:canon-c19-e2soft); the configuration is then the MEDIAN OF THREE. The book, the lever (the e2 rung's cost alone, 2,166 -> 1,850 in the 600-class, e1 and e3 the found book's), the predictions and the branches are those of canon_c19_e2soft_n2.json.

_arms.canon-c19-e2soft: {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.canon-c19-e2soft.json} - the same book as the pair's, byte-identical.

_alignment: Pool with the pair: `node tools/testbed/ledger/alignment_check.mjs --arm <sessA>,<sessB>:canon-c19-e2soft`; the run-level stop and the capital-abundance flag apply.
_caveats: Launch ONLY through tools/testbed/launch_detached.ps1 CALLED DIRECTLY from the PowerShell tool (landmine L30); the STOP file must be absent; the five-minute smoke check.
